## Selected projects

- [Data4Change Hackathon](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/hackathon-1): Participation in the Data4Change hackathon, focused on using data and technology to drive positive social change.
- [WFEO Hackathon - Urban Resource Loop](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/hackathon-2): AI and Blockchain-powered circular infrastructure for plastic and water resource recovery in Yaoundé, addressing SDG 11: Sustainable Cities and Communities.
- [e-KIOSQUE Site Dashboard](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/1): An interactive dashboard to visualize sales data, track key performance indicators and identify trends using real-time data streams.
- [Film Audience Prediction with AI](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/2): Smart tool that predicts if a film will appeal to an Afro-descendant audience using artificial intelligence and data analysis
- [Grade Management Application](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/4): Intuitive Python grade management application, enabling input, updating and automatic student ranking, with interactive graphical visualization and results export.
- [WillBank Distributed Banking Platform](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/5): Development of a complete banking application (team of 4) based on microservices architecture, including Spring Boot backend, Angular frontend, mobile application and Dockerized infrastructure.
- [School Schedule Management Application](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/6): As project manager of a 3-person team (including myself), I led the development of a web application for schedule management. I also served as integrator for backend-frontend integration, using SCRUM, CI/CD and Trello for task management.
- [EQuizz – Teaching Quality Evaluation Platform](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/8): Led a team of 3 as Lead Developer for this full-stack application that allows students to evaluate professors at the end of the semester, measuring teaching quality and student satisfaction.
- [AI-Powered Transaction Fraud Detection: End-to-End MLOps Pipeline and Real-Time Monitoring](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/9): Complete MLOps platform for banking fraud detection using XGBoost, deployed on AWS with Docker, FastAPI, Nginx load balancing, and real-time monitoring via Prometheus/Grafana.
- [Nkulex – RAG-Based OHADA Legal Assistant](https://masewellmathurin.fr/project/11): AI legal assistant that answers OHADA law questions using over 3,000 case-law decisions, with hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25) and sourced, streamed answers.
